scope: Standalone LongCat expert component; full forward/backward and independent FP32-master updates. No attention, optimizer timing, or full Trainer acceptance.

performance.scope: Expert component forward+backward; no profiler; warmup 10, samples 30 per fresh process; fixed fixture; same-sample rank maximum followed by median.
performance.link_control: Native uses default HCCL routing. Forced RoCE and native HCCL links were not made equivalent; these are not customer 910B2C speedup claims.
performance.primary_aggregation: Median of each fresh process's 30 same-sample rank maxima; report both process medians. Pooled 60-sample medians are supplemental.
performance.hybrid_followup_note: Default mte_roce on this 910C node selected MTE for all peers; baseline follow-up medians were 82.866 and 87.259 ms, from a separate process-order experiment. This is not physical mixed-domain acceptance.

profile_scope: 64 invocations, all 16 ranks, no dropped records; AIV issue/Get-quiet intervals intersect Cube compute. Not exclusive DMA time or profiler-off latency saved.

root_cause.symptom: Ready delivery partitioned by virtual mapping base; original large receive capacity could also be insufficient.
root_cause.production_fix: Use peer RNIC registered base plus symmetric offset for RDMA; preserve MTE mappings. Grow both symmetric receive and return buffers before leasing.

cases.scope: Only per-expert forward Cube queue order changes; native binary and fixture fixed. MTE/RoCE policy remains unchanged.
cases.decision: not adopted; per-process medians do not show consistent improvement in both comparisons
